id./param/scenario/cs/a_170_cs_010.pack|cs_: "Here we are! The Crystal Kingdom of Sniflheim, home of the famous Blue Orb! It's been a wee while, but it warms my heart!
"Hmph! That must be about the only thing that IS warm around here! Let's get inside before we all freeze to death!
"What the-!? The gates are covered in ice! Look, they're frozen shut!
"How strange... Still, I suppose it's only natural they'd ice up in a climate as cold as this.
"Natural, my foot! What about all the people inside? How are they supposed to live if they can't get in or out?
"Aye, ye've a point there, lassie. They've always kept the main gate free of frost, even in the dead of winter...
"So what are we supposed to do? There's an Orb in there we need to get to.
"Well, if we cannae go in through the front door, we'll just have to head round the back!
